sources.title: GitHub - talmolab/sleap: A deep learning framework for multi-animal ...
sources.snippet: SLEAP is an open-source deep-learning based framework for multi-animal pose tracking (Pereira et al., Nature Methods, 2022). It can be used to track any type or number of animals and includes an advanced labeling/training GUI for active learning and proofreading.
